news.headline: Rare Baby Rhino Takes Its First Steps at Chester Zoo
news.body: A rare greater one-horned rhino calf was born at Chester Zoo in England after its mom, Asha, was pregnant for 15 months. Cameras filmed the wobbly first steps, and keepers say mom and baby are both healthy. This kind of rhino is threatened, so every birth helps.

news.headline: Cargo Ship Set to Fly Science and Supplies to the Space Station
news.body: A Cygnus XL spacecraft is scheduled to launch on a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket from Florida on Sunday, Nov. 29. It will carry about 11,000 pounds of science experiments and supplies to the astronauts on the International Space Station.
